- [🪵 Deck Joist Span & Footing Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=deck-joist-span-calculator): Check how far a joist can safely span: pick the lumber size, spacing, wood type and load, and get the maximum span plus the beam and post spacing to match.
- [🪵 Decking Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=decking-calculator): Calculate boards, joists, posts, screws, and total cost for a timber decking project. Works for softwood, hardwood, and composite decking.
- [💡 Downlight Spacing Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=downlight-spacing-calculator): A common rule is spacing ≈ 0.5–0.75 × ceiling height, with the first lamp about half that from the wall. Check beam angle and joists — this is a layout sketch, not a lighting design.
- [🧱 Drywall (Plasterboard) Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=drywall-calculator): Order the right amount of board: enter the wall and ceiling area, pick a sheet size and wastage, and get the sheet count plus the joint compound, tape and screws to finish it.
- [🏗️ Fence Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=fence-calculator): Calculate posts, panels, gravel boards, concrete, and total cost for a garden fence. Works for panel fencing, closeboard, and picket styles.
- [🌱 Plant Spacing Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=garden-plant-spacing-calculator): How many plants fit a bed at a given spacing. Square grid is simplest; triangular (hex) packing fits about 15% more. Leave paths out of the length and width.
- [🪨 Gravel & Aggregate Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=gravel-calculator): Calculate how much gravel, slate, chippings, or aggregate you need for driveways, paths, patios, or garden beds. Includes tonnes, bulk bags, and cost.
- [🧱 Grout & Tile Adhesive Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=grout-adhesive-calculator): The tiles are one thing — the grout and adhesive to fix them are another. Enter the tiled area, tile size and joint width to work out how much grout and thinset to mix.
- [🧊 Insulation Savings Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=insulation-calculator): Estimate how much you could save by insulating your loft, walls, or floor. Based on UK energy prices.
- [🪵 Laminate Flooring Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=laminate-flooring-calculator): Work out how many packs of laminate to buy: enter the room, the plank size, planks per pack and pack price, and this adds the wastage so you don't run short mid-lay.
- [🛏️ Mattress Size Converter](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mattress-size-converter): UK, US and EU bed names are not the same size. A UK king is 150 × 200 cm; a US king is 193 × 203 cm. Fitted sheets do not stretch that gap. Depth (deep-fitted) is separate.
- [📐 Miter & Bevel Angle Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=miter-bevel-angle-calculator): Set the saw for a perfect corner: enter the corner angle and pick flat or crown molding, and get the miter and bevel angles to dial in.
- [🍂 Mulch Coverage Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mulch-coverage-calculator): Volume = area × depth. A 50 litre bag is 0.05 m³. Bark mulch is usually 5–8 cm; paths can be 10 cm. Order a little extra for settling — bags are sold by loose volume.
- [🎨 Paint Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=paint-calculator): Calculate exactly how much paint you need for any room. No more buying 5 tins for a cupboard.
- [🖼️ Picture Hanging Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=picture-hanging-guide): Calculate the perfect height and hook position so your pictures hang straight and look professional.
- [🪣 Plastering Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=plastering-calculator): Calculate how much plaster, render, or screed you need for walls, ceilings, or floors. Includes bags, coverage, and estimated cost.
- [🔧 Pipe Sizing Guide](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=plumbing-pipe-sizing): Look up the right pipe diameter for any domestic plumbing job. Covers hot/cold water, central heating, and waste.
- [🏊 Pool & Spa Volume](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=pool-spa-volume-calculator): Litres and gallons from length, width and average depth. Rectangular, circular and oval. Chemical dosing is per 1,000 litres — this is volume only, not a treatment plan.
- [📽️ Projector Throw Distance](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=projector-throw-distance-calculator): Throw ratio = distance to screen ÷ image width. A 1.5:1 lens 3 m from the wall makes a 2 m wide picture. 16:9 assumed unless you change it. Check the projector’s own min/max zoom range.
- [🌧️ Rainwater Harvest](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=rainwater-harvest-calculator): 1 mm of rain on 1 m² is 1 litre. Multiply by a runoff coefficient (tiles ~0.85, felt ~0.8). UK roofs often yield more than a water-butt can hold — size the tank, not just the dream.
- [🏠 Roof Pitch & Rafter Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=roof-pitch-rafter-calculator): Roof pitch is the rise in inches for every 12" of run. Enter the pitch and half-span (run), and get the rafter length, angle and roof-area multiplier.
- [🌡️ Room BTU & HVAC Sizing Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=room-btu-hvac-calculator): Estimate the heating and cooling load for a room: area, ceiling height, insulation, sun exposure, occupancy and climate all move the number of BTUs you need.
- [🛋️ Room Layout Planner](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=room-layout-planner): Drag and drop furniture to plan your room layout. Scale-accurate 2D top-down view.
- [🔩 Screw & Drill Bit Size Chart](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=screw-drill-chart): Look up the right drill bit for any screw size, wall plug colour, and pilot hole diameter. No more guessing.
- [📏 Shelf Bracket Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=shelf-bracket-calculator): Calculate the right bracket size, spacing, and load capacity for your shelf project.
- [🗑️ Skip Hire Volume Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=skip-hire-volume-calculator): Rough cubic yards from room waste, rubble or bags. UK skips are sold in yards: 4, 6, 8, 12, 16. Loose waste settles; rubble is heavy — many yards cap weight before the skip looks full. Not a quote.

- [🧱 Stud & Wall Framing Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=stud-framing-calculator): Frame a wall the way a carpenter would: enter the wall length, stud spacing, openings and corners, and get the stud count, plate lumber and headers to order.
- [🧱 Tile & Flooring Estimator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=tile-flooring-estimator): Calculate tiles, planks, or carpet needed for any room — including waste and cuts.
- [📺 TV Viewing Distance Calculator](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=tv-viewing-distance-calculator): Recommend a sofa distance from screen diagonal and resolution. ## 🕹 MrProphecy Arcade (29 tools)

- [🎲 Backgammon](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-backgammon): Classic backgammon: move your pieces around the board and bear them off first. Roll dice and race against the AI!
- [🔴⚫ Checkers / Draughts](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-checkers): Classic checkers with mandatory jumps and king promotion. Click a piece then click where to move. Play against the AI.
- [♟️ Chess](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-chess): Play chess against a simple AI. Full rules: castling, en passant, pawn promotion. Click a piece then click where to move.
- [🔴⚫ Connect Four](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-connect-four): Drop discs to connect four in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Play against a smart AI with animations.
- [🁣 Dominoes](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-dominoes): Block dominoes: match ends to play your tiles. If you can't play, draw from the boneyard. Lowest hand score wins!
- [🎲 Ludo](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-ludo): Race your 4 tokens from start to home! Roll a 6 to enter the board. Land on opponents to send them back. 2-4 player local.
- [🪨 Mancala](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-mancala): Ancient strategy game — sow seeds around the board, capture your opponent's stones. Free turn if your last seed lands in your store.
- [⚬ Nine Men's Morris](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-nine-mens-morris): Place and slide pieces to form mills (3 in a row). A mill lets you remove an opponent's piece. Reduce them to 2 to win!
- [⚫⚪ Othello (Reversi)](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-othello): Place discs to flip your opponent's pieces. The player with the most discs when the board is full wins. Play against a strategic AI.
- [🐍 Snakes & Ladders](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-snakes-ladders): Roll the dice and race to square 100! Ladders boost you up, snakes drag you down. Play against the AI on a beautiful animated board.
- [🎲 Yahtzee](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=boardgame-yahtzee): Roll five dice up to three times per turn. Score in 13 categories. Get the highest total!
- [📈 Coordinates Trainer](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=coordinates-trainer): Read points and plot your own on a −5 to +5 grid. Learn the four quadrants, the meaning of (x, y) and how negative coordinates work — with instant feedback and 5-question rounds. All on your device.
- [🚩 Country Flags Quiz](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=country-flags-quiz): Guess the country from its flag, or pick the right flag for a named country — with three difficulty pools, ten questions per round and colour-based clues. All drawn locally, nothing sent anywhere.
- [🧭 Grid Reference Trainer (OS)](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=grid-reference-trainer): Learn four- and six-figure Ordnance Survey grid references on a visual grid — remember: eastings (across) first, northings (up) second.
- [🧠 MrProphecy: Beat Memory](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-beat-memory): Simon-style pad memory that grows by one step each round, scored over real MrProphecy tracks. Audio starts with the game.
- [🏃 MrProphecy: Beat Runner](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=mrprophecy-beat-runner): Endless runner starring MrProphecy. Jump the gaps, build speed, and the soundtrack is real MrProphecy tracks — playback only begins when you hit start.

## 🤖 AI & Autonomous Agents (10 tools)

- [🔄 AI Agent ReAct Loop Studio](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-agent-react-loop-simulator): Autonomous agent execution cycle simulator (Yao et al., Princeton). Visualizes Thought $\to$ Action $\to$ Observation state transitions and recursion limit safeguards.
- [🧠 AI Chain-of-Thought Parser](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-chain-of-thought-scratchpad): Reasoning token extractor for o1, o3, DeepSeek-R1, and Claude Extended Thinking. Separates internal scratchpad reasoning from client-facing output and detects cognitive self-corrections.
- [📊 AI Context Window Budget Lab](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-context-window-budget-calc): LLM token budget architect. Allocates context capacity across system prompt, RAG retrieval chunks, few-shots, conversation history, and reasoning tokens to prevent catastrophic truncation.
- [⚡ AI Few-Shot Prompt Builder](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool.html?card=ai-few-shot-prompt-synthesizer): In-context learning exemplar synthesizer. Enforces structured framing (XML tags vs JSON vs Markdown) and validates class distribution balance to prevent majority label bias.
